Experimental_Design.Conditions: matching, nonmatching (association: self vs stranger, using nonword stimuli)

Trial_Structure.Stimulus_duration: Until response or maximum 1500 ms (nonword-label pair)
Trial_Structure.ITI: 500 ms black screen at trial start
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: / (feedback 'incorrect'/'please respond faster' on error or timeout)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Nonwords phonologically resembling German words: sfartku, ambelde, teirnen, kes, muf, lor (3 or 7 characters)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: German words: Ich (I), Fremder (stranger); Courier New 18-pt

exp2.detail: Association phase: nonword-concept pairs presented 4 times for 3000 ms each, alternating between self-associated and stranger-associated pairs. Study 2 was preregistered (osf.io/s68pm). Data contain 33 participants x 128 trials (CSV Sample_Size 33 / Valid_Subj 31 / Drop_Subj 2; subject 01 incomplete excluded from Clean; N caliber difference tracked in PROJ_STATE.md stage 4). Method source: paper full text (Springer).
